programme.title: Freaky
programme.desc: Millie (Kathryn Newton) lives in a small American town and struggles with numerous problems.He can only count on a pair of loyal friends, Josh (Misha Osherovich) and Nyla (Celeste O'Connor).She is ridiculed by her peers and has just lost her father.To make matters worse, he becomes the target of a psychopath roaming the area, the Blissfield Butcher (Vince Vaughn).The bloody incident has surprising consequences - the girl, stabbed with an antique dagger on a moonlit night, magically switches bodies with her tormentor.In the morning he wakes up as a wanted murderer, and the Butcher can now go hunting in the form of a delicate blonde.Millie has only 24 hours to reverse the spell.Christopher Landon, the creator of "Die Another Day", pays tribute to the classics of horror cinema.He skillfully plays with convention, referring to "Halloween" or "Scream".

programme.title: Death Of A Comedian
programme.desc: Argentine actor Juan Debré (Diego Peretti) receives a disturbing diagnosis at the peak of his career.He escapes to Belgium to immerse himself in his own, safe reality.

programme.title: Closer
programme.desc: London.Stripper and waitress Alice (Natalie Portman) has a minor accident on the street.Writer Dan (Jude Law) takes her to the hospital.They fall in love with each other almost at first sight and move in together.A few months later, Dan falls in love with talented photographer Anna (Julia Roberts).Although she is not indifferent to the writer, knowing about his relationship with Alice, she does not want to meet him.To take revenge, Dan impersonates her in one of the erotic chat rooms and starts a spicy conversation with doctor Larry (Clive Owen).The first real meeting between Larry and Anna is quite unfortunate, but soon they both fall in love and get married.After some time, the woman meets Dan again and the old fascination is revived.Meanwhile, Larry meets Alice and falls under her spell.Adapted from a play by Patrick Marber.Clive Owen and Natalie Portman received Golden Globe and Oscar nominations.

programme.title: The Pig Who Cried Werewolf
programme.desc: A bad wolf lives next to three little pigs, Heimlich, Dieter and Chef.The first of them discovers that under the influence of the moon he transforms into a woman who is obsessed with catching pigs.

programme.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
programme.desc: London, 1970.Farrokh "Freddie" Bulsara (Rami Malek) works at Heathrow Airport.One day he meets Mary Austin (Lucy Boynton), who becomes his girlfriend.He also meets members of the band Smile - drummer Roger Taylor (Ben Hardy) and guitarist Brian May (Gwilym Lee).The musicians are looking for a new vocalist.It becomes Freddie.Additionally, bassist John Deacon (Joe Mazzello) joins the group.Some time later they record their debut album.Soon, Freddie changes the band's name to Queen and his surname to Mercury.The artists come under the wing of manager John Reid (Aidan Gillen) and release a new album, and then go on tour around the United States.Even though Freddie proposes to Mary, during the trip he begins to question his own sexuality.In 1975, the album "A Night at the Opera" was released, which included, among others:the song "Bohemian Rhapsody".The composition becomes the reason for the breakup with the current manager, but also makes the musicians real stars.

programme.title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
programme.desc: 13-year-old Harry Potter spends his next holidays with his aunt and uncle, the Dursleys.So far, he has been very obedient and has never once used magic outside his school, in accordance with the regulations in force.Eventually, however, his mischievous Aunt Marge throws him off balance.Using his magical skills, the boy causes the woman to inflate like a balloon and fly away.Harry, terrified by the prospect of the punishment his guardians would surely inflict on him, runs away from them at night.The Knight-Errant's multi-decker bus takes him to a pub where the Minister of Magic, Cornelius Fudge, is waiting for him.He offers the young wizard a place to stay.His strange behavior catches Potter's attention.It turns out that Sirius Black escaped from Azkaban.He allegedly caused the death of Harry's parents, and now he plans to kill their son.Hogwarts is guarded by Dementors, who are the guards of Azkaban.Harry feels paralyzing fear of them.He must defeat him to face the enemy.

programme.title: The Doll
programme.desc: Rémi did not recover from the breakup.In order to function, he remains in a relationship with the doll Audrey, with whom he lives and shares everyday affairs.One day, a new colleague shows up at his company.

programme.title: Maid in Manhattan
programme.desc: New York.Divorcee Marisa Ventura (Jennifer Lopez) raises her son alone.She works as a maid at the luxurious Beresford Hotel in Manhattan.While cleaning the apartment of aristocrat Caroline Lane (Natasha Richardson), the woman tries on her elegant outfit, in which she looks exceptionally nice.Another hotel guest sees her so changed.He is lawyer Christopher Matthew (Ralph Fiennes), running for parliament.He takes Marisa as a person of a similar social status to himself.They go for a walk together and then eat dinner together.The woman cannot bring herself to correct the mistake, especially since she likes Christopher.However, it is not known how the future senator will react to the fact that his chosen one is an ordinary girl from the Bronx... The luxurious Beresford hotel, where the main character of the film works, is in fact the famous Waldorf-Astoria on Park Avenue.

programme.title: Dune: Part Two
programme.desc: After an insidious attack by the Harkonnens and the death of his father, Paul Atreides (Timothée Chalamet) and his pregnant mother, Jessica (Rebecca Ferguson), hide in the desert among the Fremen.There, a young man's feelings for Chani (Zendaya) sprout.At the same time, he matures spiritually.The leader of the wandering people, Stilgar (Javier Bardem), closely observes the only descendant of the Atreides family and becomes convinced that he is the chosen one, whose coming has been predicted for generations.However, to be accepted by the Fremen, Paul must pass the ultimate test by riding a monstrous worm.Meanwhile, Baron Vladimir Harkonnen (Stellan Skarsgard) finds out that Paul is alive.He knows he has to hurry.He decides to take control of the entire planet Arrakis.He starts launching attack after attack.A continuation of the spectacular production from 2021, which was awarded six Oscars.Both films are adaptations of the famous science fiction novel by Frank Herbert.

programme.title: Focus
programme.desc: Nicky Spurgeon is a calculating fraud.The model's appearance and ability to keep cool make him a master criminal.He is able to win people over, but he does it to take advantage of them.One day, in a restaurant, he meets a fair-haired beauty, Jess Barrett, whose ambition is to pursue a criminal career.He becomes her mentor.Over time, they both realize that they have much more in common than the relationship of master and disciple.However, they live in a world where there is no place for love.Spurgeon ends this relationship.Three years pass.Nicky is in Buenos Aires, where he works for the owner of a car racing team, Rafael Garrigi.He meets his former lover here.Aware of her strengths, the femme fatale has one goal - to take revenge for the way she was once treated.

programme.title: Wuthering Heights
programme.desc: Yorkshire.Catherine Earnshaw (Margot Robbie) begins a love relationship with the stray Heathcliff (Jacob Elordi), taken in by her father.The forbidden feeling has a destructive effect on both of them.

programme.title: Euphoria
programme.desc: The further fate of a group of friends who left school behind and entered adulthood.The action moves forward several years.Rue (Zendaya Coleman) is no longer a lost teenager, but a person involved in the criminal world.He goes to interrogation in connection with smuggling drugs from Mexico.Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) and Maddy's (Alexa Demie) relationship has improved, but old wounds haven't healed at all.The first woman's relationship with Nate (Jacob Elordi) develops, but not towards a happy ending.The remaining characters confront their own choices, addiction and violence.They are looking for redemption and answers to the question about their place in the world.

programme.title: Peacemaker 2
programme.desc: Two years have passed since the last events.Chris Smith (John Cena) considers himself a real hero.However, he must earn the recognition of other heroes.

programme.title: NO
programme.desc: Animal tamer OJ Haywood (Daniel Kaluuya) and his sister Emerald (Keke Palmer) live on a ranch in southern California where horses are trained for Hollywood film productions.They take over the business of their father, who died in suspicious circumstances.Problems are piling up for them.One day they become witnesses of inexplicable phenomena.Together with a former child star (Steven Yeun), an emcee at a family amusement park, they try to film supernatural incidents to make money by selling sensational materials.Their actions have unforeseen consequences.Director Jordan Peele made his debut in 2017 with the acclaimed thriller "Get Out!", for which he won an Oscar for the script.

programme.title: Man on Fire
programme.desc: American John Creasy (Denzel Washington) is a man haunted by nightmares from his past.He is a former assassin who worked for the CIA for many years.Frustrated, he avoids people and seeks solace in alcohol.Creasy comes to Mexico to visit his old friend and colleague, Rayburn (Christopher Walken).The city is currently gripped by a wave of kidnappings for ransom.Rich residents panic and many of them hire security guards to ensure the safety of their children.A friend finds John a job as a bodyguard for ten-year-old Pita Ramos (Dakota Fanning), the daughter of Mexican industrialist Samuel Ramos (Marc Anthony) and his American wife Lisa (Radha Mitchell).At first, Creasy has a hard time coping with the girl's presence.Over time, however, he becomes friends with her.Under its influence, he changes his attitude to life and gives up alcohol.Soon, however, little Pita is kidnapped.The desperate man does everything to save her.

programme.title: Neighbors 2: Sorority Rising
programme.desc: Mac (Seth Rogen) and Kelly (Rose Byrne) Radner have decided to sell their house and move to a better neighborhood.They are thirty trial days away from finalizing the contract, during which time potential buyers can conduct an inspection and, if they don't like anything, break the contract.It's bad luck that students from the Kappa Nu sorority show up in the area.Shelby (Chloë Grace Moretz), Beth (Kiersey Clemons) and Nora (Beanie Feldstein) - just like their predecessors - love to throw parties.The Radners must enlist the help of their old enemy, Teddy Sanders (Zac Efron).The recent college star is struggling with his own issues.Lonely, he wants to be needed by someone at all costs.

programme.title: Olivia and the Invisible Earthquake
programme.desc: Twelve-year-old Olivia, together with her younger brother Tim and her mother, must suddenly leave their current apartment and start all over again in a strange neighborhood.Wanting to protect Tim from fear and alleviate his sense of loss, the girl tells him that their move is part of the film in which he is the main character.This challenge to their imagination helps them come to terms with difficult reality.Over time, through new friendships, fun, and even a bit of magic, the siblings discover that they can truly take responsibility for their story.

programme.title: Focus
programme.desc: Nicky Spurgeon is a calculating fraud.The model's appearance and ability to keep cool make him a master criminal.He is able to win people over, but he does it to take advantage of them.One day, in a restaurant, he meets a fair-haired beauty, Jess Barrett, whose ambition is to pursue a criminal career.He becomes her mentor.Over time, they both realize that they have much more in common than the relationship of master and disciple.However, they live in a world where there is no place for love.Spurgeon ends this relationship.Three years pass.Nicky is in Buenos Aires, where he works for the owner of a car racing team, Rafael Garrigi.He meets his former lover here.Aware of her strengths, the femme fatale has one goal - to take revenge for the way she was once treated.

programme.title: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: Harold Crick is a lonely clerk who carefully plans each day.One day he discovers that he is constantly accompanied by a mysterious narrative coming from nowhere.A female voice constantly comments on all his actions.A concerned man goes to a psychiatrist, but he cannot determine what may be wrong with his patient.Literature specialist, Professor Jules Hilbert, suggests to Harold that he is the hero of a book by the famous writer, Karen Eiffel.What's worse, the author usually annihilates the main characters of her works.Crick finds the woman and begs her to spare his life.The eccentric artist suffers from a lack of creative inspiration.Despite the support of his assistant, Penny, he has trouble figuring out how to get rid of Harold.He does everything he can to stop the writer before inspiration returns to her.

programme.title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
programme.desc: Harry Potter begins his fourth year at the School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.The Triwizard Tournament is also approaching, with representatives of the three most prestigious universities taking part: Hogwarts, Beauxbatons and Durmstrang.The Goblet of Fire predicts the players.Harry Potter is also one of the lucky ones, even though he has not reached the required age.The young wizard's friends, Hermione and Ron, sense that there is some trick behind it.Regardless of the suspicions, the boy must face three competition tasks.In addition, he must also face his greatest enemy - Lord Voldemort.The fourth volume of the popular series of novels by J.K.Rowling was successfully brought to the screen by Mike Newell, the creator of the hits "Four Weddings and a Funeral" and "Donnie Brasco".The film received, among others:Oscar nomination for scenography.

programme.title: Sarah Bernhardt, la divine
programme.desc: The beginning of the 20th century.The outstanding French actress Sarah Bernhardt (Sandrine Kiberlain) is considered one of the most important artists of her time and has the status of an international star.Her admirers include Oscar Wilde, Alfons Mucha and Victor Hugo.Her talent and extraordinary charisma, as well as her courage and extravagant lifestyle are widely admired.The actress disrupted social norms and shocked her contemporaries with her unusual preferences and numerous love affairs.She was a declared opponent of anti-Semitism.Fate connected her most closely with the actor Lucien Guitry (Laurent Lafitte) and the painter Louise Abbéma (Amira Casar).Since her fateful fall on stage in 1905 in Rio de Janeiro, Divine Sarah has been struggling with terrible knee pain, which over the years has made it impossible for her to move.In order to be able to perform, after a decade, the actress makes a dramatic decision.Full of passion and inner strength, the artist will forever be remembered in the history of art and culture.

programme.title: The Last Showgirl
programme.desc: After thirty years, dancer Shelly Gardner (Pamela Anderson) ends her career.For decades, she performed in a strip revue in Las Vegas, which was inspired by French burlesque.The stage, costumes and music are her passion, for which she sacrificed her family life and relationship with her daughter, Hannah (Billie Lourd).She shared her knowledge and experience with beginner friends Marianne (Brenda Song) and Jodie (Kiernan Shipka).One day, however, producer Eddie (Dave Bautista) announces that the show has been canceled.Devastated, Shelly must re-plan her future.A similar fate will befall her friend Annette (Jamie Lee Curtis), a dealer at an arcade.Golden Globe for Pamela Anderson.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Doug (Jack Black) and Griff (Paul Rudd) have been friends since childhood.They have always dreamed of making a remake of their favorite film, the horror film "Anaconda".When both buddies experience a midlife crisis, they decide not to wait any longer and set off together deep into the Amazon to start filming.The situation becomes more complicated when... a real giant anaconda appears on the film set, spreading chaos and destruction around.Despite the deadly threat, the friends decide to take advantage of the predator's presence.

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Small-time marijuana dealer David Clark tries to help teenagers living in his neighborhood.He is attacked by three homeless punks and robbed of his goods and cash.As a result, he becomes indebted to his supplier, Brad Gurdlinger.To repay the debt, he must import the latest batch of stimulants from Mexico.To conceal himself, he arranges helpers to pretend to be his immediate family going on holiday with him.So David's neighbors go on the road with him: cynical stripper Rose O'Reilly, the drug dealer's would-be client, the dim-witted Kenny Rossmore, and the smart, street-savvy teenager Casey Mathis.A laugh-out-loud action movie full of well-acted episodes and indecent gags.This is another joint project of Jason Sudeikis and Jennifer Aniston, after the comedies "Get Your Ex" and "Horrible Bosses".

programme.title: Amrum
programme.desc: Spring 1945. Twelve-year-old Nanning hunts seals and works hard in the fields to help his mother.He faces difficult decisions.
